2609.35645.title: CoSE-E: A Benchmark for Code-switched Speech Evaluation in Enterprise Settings
2609.35645.paper_summary: Code-switching (CS), a seamless alternation between languages within a single utterance, remains a critical challenge in automatic speech recognition (ASR). While prior works focus on conversational CS-ASR, enterprise settings demand evaluation of operational impact beyond edit-distance errors: how code-switching transcription errors propagate to downstream voice agent task failures. In this work, we propose (1) a CS-ASR synthetic benchmark and multidimensional evaluation framework tailored to enterprise domains, (2) systematic evaluation of frontier ASR systems across 5 language pairs, (3) diagnostic analysis of the additional transcription errors that code-switching introduces across language pairs and models. We release COSE-E to support enterprise-focused CSASR evaluation for multilingual voice agents in enterprise deployment.
2609.35645.paper_summary_zh: 代碼切換（CS），在單一話語中無縫地交替使用語言，仍然是自動語音識別（ASR）的一個關鍵挑戰。<lb/>雖然先前的研究專注於對話式的 CS-ASR，但企業環境需要評估操作影響，超越編輯距離錯誤：代碼切換的轉錄錯誤如何傳播到下游語音代理任務失敗。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們提出了（1）一個針對企業領域量身定制的 CS-ASR 合成基準和多維評估框架，<lb/>(2) 對 5 個語言對的前沿 ASR 系統進行系統評估，<lb/>(3) 對代碼切換在語言對和模型中引入的額外轉錄錯誤進行診斷分析。<lb/>我們發布了 COSE-E，以支持針對企業部署中的多語言語音代理的企業專注 CSASR 評估。
